quality_budget: Two conditions, both required. Floor: the served runtime passes every must-pass assertion. Non-inferiority: its task pass count on this finite suite is at least the oracle's. This is a statement about these six greedy completions, not a statistical noninferiority claim over usage. Every individual failure, including known shared ones, is reported.
rules: Each task runs from the same prompt token IDs to the end token or the output cap. A task passes when it ends with the end token within the cap, a thinking-mode answer has reasoning text, and every assertion holds on the final text. Code tests run in a scratch folder with a 60 s limit; every expected test result must be printed by the parent-written harness, so an early exit, a silent success, or a partial run fails.
